title: Box Value Index
headline_insight: A frozen box-score value index puts Nikola Jokic on top at 30.86 points of value per 36 minutes, ahead of Giannis Antetokounmpo (27.558) and Victor Wembanyama (26.261).
what_it_means: This is a transparent Win-Score-style linear index with weights fixed in advance, not tuned to any target. Its top is the expected 2023-26 MVP-tier cluster (Jokic, Giannis, Wembanyama, Doncic, Davis, Embiid, SGA), so it passes face validity. It pooled 77,744 player-game rows and ranks the 501 players who cleared the 750-minute floor.
how_to_read: The table ranks players by box_value_index_per36; a higher number means more box-score production packed into 36 minutes.
why_it_matters: Recovering the consensus star order from frozen, untuned weights is a sanity check on the underlying box-score data layer.
caveat: DESCRIPTIVE_ONLY; explicitly NOT RAPM/EPM/DARKO/LEBRON or Basketball-Reference BPM (box counting stats only, no pace/position/team adjustments). Accented names are split across two distinct player_ids upstream, so Jokic appears twice in the top rows, a data-layer join issue, not fixed here.
as_of: seasons 2023-24 through 2025-26 (no generation timestamp in artifact)
